purpose: Establish a source-anchored fixed-layer LARE research reference and compare its hydrological dynamics with fine and equal-dimension coarse Richards before any solver/product integration.

robustness_control.role: not executed in DYN0A unless D3 produces an unresolved state-information question

He_2021.citation: He et al. (2021), A two-layer numerical model of soil moisture dynamics: Model development, Journal of Hydrology 602, 126797
source_facts: fixed-layer storage balance follows integrated continuity
layer-average hydraulic functions are approximated by hydraulic functions evaluated at layer-average water content
two-layer interface flux is Eq. 24 with conductivity Eq. 23
free drainage bottom flux is Eq. 32
ODE system is solved with iterative Heun predictor-corrector

He_2026.citation: He et al. (2026), A Numerical Model for Integrated Form of Richards Equation, Hydrological Processes 40(1)
He_2026.role: confirms a generalized multilayer LARE research line exists; DYN0A does not claim byte/formula identity with the 2026 implementation because full generalized equations/code have not been independently inspected

model_definition.coordinate: depth z positive downward in the LARE research model
model_definition.conservation: dW_i/dt = q_(i-1/2) - q_(i+1/2); no sink/source in DYN0A

constitutive.inverse: psi(theta) = ((Se^(-1/m)-1)^(1/n))/alpha with psi=-h > 0 for unsaturated state
constitutive.qualified_branch: strictly unsaturated standard MvG branch only; fail OUTSIDE_QUALIFIED_DOMAIN if theta approaches endpoints or SWAP near-saturation smoothing would be entered

internal_interface.label: HE2021_EQ24_ADJACENT_FIXED_LAYER_EXTENSION
internal_interface.provenance: For N=2 this is algebraically He et al. 2021 Eq. 24/Eq. 23 after H=Delta_1+Delta_2 and beta=Delta_2/H. For N>2 DYN0A applies the same first-order two-layer interface closure pairwise to adjacent fixed layers.
internal_interface.claim_limit: source-anchored adjacent-layer extension; not claimed as exact reproduction of the uninspected 2026 generalized LARE implementation

bottom_boundaries.formula: q_bottom = K0 for each initial anchor
bottom_boundaries.purpose: controlled conservation/response experiment without an additional bottom closure

top_boundary.swap_translation: q_down = -q_native_SWAP for the explicit-flux Reference harness

numerical_reference.primary_ode_route: iterative Heun predictor-corrector with preregistered step refinement; the finest successful refinement is the DYN0A model-form numerical reference

heun_crosscheck.method: iterative Heun predictor-corrector, source-anchored to He et al. 2021
heun_crosscheck.role: source-anchored numerical-floor authority; compare successive refinements and use the finest successful route for hydrological comparison

hard_invariants: theta_r < theta_i < theta_s on qualified steps
exact discrete water ledger to floating-point tolerance
uniform equilibrium remains invariant under q_top=q_bottom=K0

fine_reference.route: current admitted Reference Richards research harness

coarse_richards_D3.requirement: exact same fixed layer boundaries as LARE D3

adjudication.first_question: Does LARE D3 preserve projected fine-Reference storage and bottom exchange better than coarse Richards D3 on the same three-layer geometry?
adjudication.secondary_question: Does D2 remain purpose-useful despite known state aliasing?

deferred: prescribed bottom-head closure and groundwater reversal DYN0B

failed_runs.observation: unbounded DOP853 internal stage entered theta outside the qualified 0<Se<1 constitutive branch; no DYN0A result artifact was produced
failed_runs.disposition: remove DOP853 as authority and use the source-anchored iterative Heun refinement ladder as the numerical-floor authority; forcing, state, closure and partitions unchanged

failed_runs.observation: fine 16x10 cm Reference completed all four fixed-flux histories at Se0=0.65, then failed closed on the first free-drainage history because mode 7 has no previously qualified strict-first fallback authority
failed_runs.disposition: split DYN0A-FX fixed-flux comparison from DYN0A-FD free-drainage comparison. DYN0A-FX proceeds unchanged. DYN0A-FD remains BLOCKED_REFERENCE_MODE7_QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED; no new fallback is invented here.

preflight_reconciliation.scientific_firewall: No successful LARE-vs-Richards hydrological comparison was observed before this reconciliation; no forcing amplitude, partition, metric or purpose criterion is changed.

DYN0A_FX.histories: all preregistered Se0 and top-forcing sequences
DYN0A_FX.comparator: fine Reference Richards plus equal-dimension D3 and D2 coarse Richards

pre_successful_comparison_freeze.common_case_rule: For each partition, compare only cases that are QUALIFIED for the LARE finest Heun route, fine Reference Richards, and the equal-partition coarse Richards comparator. Exclusion is permitted only for preregistered OUTSIDE_QUALIFIED_DOMAIN or BLOCKED_REFERENCE_NUMERICAL_QUALIFICATION status, never because an observed hydrological error is large.
fixed_flux_discriminating_outputs: per-layer storage error versus projection of fine Reference onto the same fixed partition
maximum absolute layer-storage error over time
middle/upper layer redistribution error where the partition contains those layers
pre_successful_comparison_freeze.interpretation: Because q_top and q_bottom are prescribed in DYN0A-FX and no sinks exist, total storage and bottom exchange are largely boundary-ledger quantities and are not sufficient evidence that the internal LARE closure is accurate.

paired_comparator_rule.D3: Compare LARE D3 and coarse Richards D3 against the same projected fine-Reference D3 storage trajectory for every common qualified case.
paired_comparator_rule.D2: Compare LARE D2 and coarse Richards D2 against the same projected fine-Reference D2 storage trajectory for every common qualified case.
paired_comparator_rule.report: Per-case error vectors, aggregate maxima/means, and counts of cases in which LARE is lower/equal/higher than coarse Richards for each storage metric.

pre_successful_comparison_freeze.D4_resolution_control_rule: Do not introduce D4 merely to improve a poor D3 result. Execute D4 only if D3 versus coarse D3 leaves an unresolved closure-resolution question, consistent with the RS1-GW closeout role already frozen before DYN0A.
pre_successful_comparison_freeze.seed_diagnostic: Report any Reference seed drift from the uniform initial state where observable; do not silently absorb seed drift into closure error.
pre_successful_comparison_freeze.scientific_effect: Interpretation and cohort governance only. No forcing amplitude, material, partition, constitutive relation, LARE interface closure or numerical threshold is changed.
